'''Sala Vindako''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who owned a caravan of exotic beasts on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Weik/Legends|Weik]].

==Biography==
A skilled [[Big game hunter/Legends|huntress]] and a trainer of wild beasts, Sala Vindako lived her entire life on the backwater world of Weik, where access to technology common throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] was limited. Portly yet agile, Vindako dressed in a thick leather coat adorned with animal teeth. During her career, she worked with her employee, [[Orl Miscord/Legends|Orl Miscord]], to capture a [[Dust stalker|dust-stalker]] in the [[Madlands]]. When rumor got out that Vindako was in possession of the legendary [[Grimoire of Syclos the Lame]], Miscord released the dust-stalker in hopes that it would kill Vindako so that he might take possession of the ancient book.<ref name="NoP" />
